remarks: Beautiful, newly renovated 15/F 1-bedroom residence w/ stunning sunrise & city views in The Biltmore Luxury Condominium building. Brand-new LVP floors throughout. Kitchen w/ new white quartz countertops, new wood cabinetry, new appliances. Freshly painted walls w/ elegant crown moldings. Ceramic tile flooring in kitchen & bathroom. The Biltmore amenities include 24/7 concierge, 2,000 SQFT fitness center, private courtyard, lounge. Across the street is Stamford Town Center Mall w/ Macy's, Pickleball America, Foot Locker, etc. Nearby has fine dining, shopping, entertainment, library, banks, theaters. Building is pet-friendly (size limit) and allows 60-day minimum rentals. Stamford Train Station is less than 1 mile. Attached garage company charges approx. $120/month. Move-in ready. Impeccably updated. Experience luxury downtown living at its best.
